TAL_WAX_TEMPERED_SEALANT.why: Tempered Sealant: Set Wax ramparts avoid double Fire damage unless the source is higher level or overwhelming (combat/ext/wax_rampart.py).

TAL_WAX_FUNERAL_CANDLE_SHELTER.why: Funeral Candle Shelter: when a creature you can see within 60 feet would die from damage, your Reaction and 5 CP keep it at 0 Hit Points, Stable (once per fight each) (combat/ext/wax_candle.py).

tianxia.talent.warleader.focusing_tactic.why: Focusing Tactics: a Commanded ally under your active Standard (or affected by your Shout) may use its Action to restore your absent Martial Focus, once per fight each (combat/ext/warleader_herdsman.py).

tianxia.talent.thread.qi_thread_scriptur.why: Qi Thread Scripture: one Qi Thread (1 CP) lasts 10 minutes and makes every Draw the Line a 30-foot Qi Thread line at no further cost; Thread Line limit +1 (combat/ext/thread_weaving.py).

tianxia.talent.thread.hundred_line_weavi.why: Hundred-Line Weaving: Thread Line limit +2; Draw the Line may take a second target for 1 more CP; Tension Mastery keeps one ending line a turn longer (combat/ext/thread_weaving.py).

TAL_SOUND_HARMONIC_WEAKNESS.why: Harmonic Weakness: a map object your Sound talent damages rings until the start of your next turn; the next damage it takes adds one Sound Die (1d6 / 1d8 / 1d10 / 2d8 by Realm) (combat/ext/sound_structures.py).

TAL_SNIPER_THROUGH_THE_WRONG_DOOR.why: Through the Wrong Door: a Bouncing Shot ignores the target's Half and Three-Quarters Cover and, since it already expended Martial Focus, the Disadvantage for a target you cannot see but whose place you know (combat/ext/sniper_angles.py).

TAL_QIWEAVING_STABILIZING_CIRCUIT.why: Stabilizing Circuit: when you apply Stable Modulation, +Proficiency Bonus on the first Concentration saving throw for that technique before the start of your next turn (combat/ext/qiweaving_modulation.py).
